notes.title: Patch 1.0.6
notes.content: [p]Added Italian Localization, mamma mia[/p][p]Added effect that shows when someone is poisoned[/p][p]Fixed a line in encounter 2 of Vagrant Fly[/p][p]QoL changes to the way ammo is stacked and updated, now the game will try to "resupply" your current ammo stack before sending ammo to your inventory[/p][p]Non-host players can now see their buffs when they eat fish (wow, finally)[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.content:
Removed crouch wiggle

Players can now see other players crouching when they are crouching, amazing

Added options to increase and uncap the framerate, some characters may look Funky when the framerate is above 60, otherwise the game should be playable

Added camera bob slider, experimental feature

Fixed spider AI when playing coop

Changed the animation of the second attack on fist weapons to allow for more reach

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
Localised the game to spanish, ole ole los caracole
Due to localization, some text has been changed in a few places to make work easier for future localizations

Added missing event: a new dialogue encounter in the swamp for nameless flyknight, he can be found in the blue magical tower on saves that have not advanced past his 2nd encounter

Fixed an issue where changing camera sensitivity would save the changes to savedata but not apply them on the character

The bell in the starting town can now be rung, incredible

Added icons to both summoning spells

Added a text indicator when an enemy is parried, same way it showed if a hit was "Blocked" or "Deflected"

Nature's Spit now targets all body parts inside the area that spawns on collision

Adjusted the way parrypush works to account for attack rate

Parrypush now accounts for stamina usage value

Removed the smear effect because it was making weapons appear dark on users that were using Vulkan renderer, it might come back some day

Water shader has been altered so it's visible for users that for any reason are not rendering distance field effects

Fixed loot dropped by FlyTraps and Barnacles that was out of sync with the server, resulting in ghost items

Adjusted some logic to a certain NPC fight that happens near the end of the game to prevent the character from speaking while it dies, hopefully

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
Reworked changes from last patch which was preemptively rolled out.

Important changes to chests and personal stashes were made to prevent stash wipes and empty chests on non-host players.

Fixed a bug where chests and stash inventories would only save the next to last action that you made on it as a non-host player.

Changes to savedata were made to prevent data corruption.

Important change to equipment weight, from all the equipped weapons, only the one currently held in hand is added to equipment weight, the tooltip in the menu has changed to reflect this. Armor weight and spells weight still apply as usual.
This change was made to encourage players to have a variety of weapons on hand at all times to deal with all kinds of weaknesses and enemy types.


Fixed a couple of attacks from the pillbug pugilist that had no damage type assigned, bypassing characters defences.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2e
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where the Swarm spell would ignore the quarrel preventer ring

Altered some settings in the visuals of the lootable objects on the ground as an attempt at fixing the LowLevelFatalerror crash that some users are experiencing

Altered some ways in which player data is created, loaded, and saved in an attempt at fixing data creation/corruption. 
If a savegame could not be created you will get a warning in the main menu, you can still create a character and load into the game, chests and doors should work but your progress will not get saved. 
A common thread to this problem seems to be Windows 11 and likely its antivirus but we don't know for sure yet.

Reworked the way chests work to prevent them for not showing loot to certain players during coop

Leaf Spear has been buffed

notes.title: Small patch 1.0.2f
notes.content:
Added back cut content: a ring that enables a dodge maneuver, it's somewhere in the swamp

Fixed a bug where clients would use stamina twice as fast as the host, whoops

Fixed a bug where you'd use less stamina while wearing more weight (nobody reported this???) now equipment weight is not considered for stamina usage at all, only for regeneration

notes.title: Micropatch 1.0.2e
notes.content:
Changed some default values in an attempt at fixing the savedata corruption or missing bug where players would not be able to move the camera around, this does not fix the problem of data not saving but at least you can play the game

Inventory stash size has been changed from 80 to 152 ONLY for new characters, it's too dangerous to change data of old characters

Added a couple of vital items to the bottom of the stash in case the player misses them

notes.title: Loot changes patch 1.0.2d
notes.content:
Fixed the Sunlit Hoops which was affecting only the host and only when killing certain enemy types

Changes to ways of obtaining the following items that previously could only be obtained by 1 of the players in the game dropped from a crate:

[list]
[*] The Lavender Ring has been moved to a chest
[*] The mighty Leek has been added to the Flytrap's drop pool
[*] Parrying Shield and Estoc have been put together in a chest
[*] Mystical Twig bow has been added to the Antman Archer's drop pool
[*] Ring of Leaves has been added to the BarnaclePlant's drop pool
[*] The Ring of the Sniper has been moved to a chest
[*] The Swarm spell has been moved to a chest
[/list]
Antman Archer now drops less arrows

Fixed a bug where the second boss would only update its healthbar to the Host

Ring of leaves now only affects the pushes from kicks made by the character wearing it, as stated in its description (sorry speedrunners)
Same deal with Ring of Bricks
Ring of leaves has been buffed to increase the pushback from 200% to 250% (speedrunners rejoice!)

Changed the collision of the dummy asset which was yeeting players to the stratosphere occasionally

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2c
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that was allowing players to hit the Create character button several times, causing shenanigans

Altered the entrance of the second boss arena to allow players to go back to the bonfire after defeating it

Added missing text to the second boss' death bark

Changed check icon in menus

Added Mesh AO setting, deactivating this setting mostly makes the game uglier at no change in performance but could help players that are getting crashes due to old or weird GPUs

Adjusted how the player takes damage to avoid receiving a lot of unintended hits in a short amount of time

Multiplayer damage scaling now does not factor in hits received by other players

Fixed an issue where under certain circunstances the camera would rotate sideways

Fixed one of Lunamoth's attacks was doing no damage (??????)

Changed the cave entrance geometry to express that the FlyKnight will not get back out anytime soon

notes.title: Small patch 1.0.2b
notes.content:
Removed a ghost cylinder in a remote location

Traveling between levels has been changed a bit, it should prevent Clients getting booted to the main menu when the Host travels to a new location

Fixed a bug where private online sessions would become un-private

Can now rebind up, down, left, right keyboard keys

Added individual axis settings for X and Y axis

Removed camera smoothing setting, it wasn't doing anyhing, lmao

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2a
notes.content: Fixed a bug where if the host interacted with a stash before a client did, it would save empty stash information to clients.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Fixed a bug regarding the container stash deleting/not saving items if it was interacted by several players at the same time, the current temporary fix involves limiting the amount of players that interact with Stash, Fish Barrels and Chests to 1 person at a time

Fixed geometry in swamp that would make players stucc

Fixed wasp high strategy strafing maneuver

Fixed a bug where deleting a save would still contain data regarding defeated bosses in that save slot position

Fixed a bug where clients would not earn the achievement for defeating the second boss

Added Vulkan rendering, if you were experiencing crashes when picking up items, try adding -vulkan in the Launch Options inside the properties panel that you can access by Right Clicking the game title on Steam

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1a
notes.content: Fixed some weapons disappearing when casting spells

notes.title: 1.0.1 Patch notes
notes.content:
Fixed a crash that occurs when in a party of 3 players or more spells were casted from the players

Nerfed Knight armor set which had incorrect values

Fixed a bug where when searching servers using a controller the server slots would not come into focus

Removed latency indicator from server slot as it always said 9999ms

Fixed a bug that would allow items to be dragged into the fish slots and then allow them to be duped

Adjusted some music tracks that were the wrong file format

Fixed a bug where interacting with two roadblocks in Ruins would activate them which is not intended

notes.title: FlyKnight Prelude FaQ
notes.content:
[h3]When will the game come out?[/h3]
Sometime later this year, either in October or November.

[h3]Why Prelude?[/h3]
This is meant to be a short experience, full featured but around the 3 hour mark, much more than a demo but less than a full game, and as such it will be low on the pricetag as well.

I would like to make this type of game in the future, properly, with more features and a proper length and story, something around the 12th hour mark, but at the moment I have a responsibility to maintain with the backers and wishlisters of my other project, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2168070/Sorceress/]Sorceress[/url].

FlyKnight Prelude is a detour I'm taking to unwind from Sorceress, quench the thirst for this type of game and gather some funds to help me on my other endeavors. Doesn't mean I'm not passionate about it, if I wanted to make money creating a cynically engineered product I'd go back to being a grunt on the games industry, which I'm trying to avoid as much as I can.

[h3]Retail price on release?[/h3]
Between 5€ and 7€, still thinking about it.

[h3]What content will be featuring in the released game?[/h3]
[list]
[*]3 levels + intro
[*]3 bosses
[*]3+ hours of total content
[/list]
[h3]What features will the game have?[/h3]
[list]
[*]Online coop multiplayer with friendly fire enabled (can be prevented by wearing a certain ring found early on)
[*]Inventory/Gear with loot and treasure to find and equip
[*]Fishing, which is non-obligatory but will give important buffs
[/list]
[h3]What features are planned post-release?[/h3]
I'm not promising any of these but:
[list]
[*]Difficulty modes
[*]NG+
[*]Randomizer
[/list]
[h3]What features will the game NOT have?[/h3]
[list]
[*]Roguelike mode
[*]Leveling up
[*]Weapon upgrades
[*]PVP Invasions
[*]gf
[/list]

[h3]Steam Deck compatible?[/h3]
Yes! This game does not use real-time lighting nor textures so it runs wonderfully on the Steam Deck and likely in a lot of potato PCs that can run Windows 10.

[h3]Any other questions you may have, feel free to post them in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3108510/discussions/0/6832610053153166627/]The Forums[/url][/h3]
